resume: AMB-1 is a generative ambient machine inspired by Brian Eno: it plays by itself from power-on (voices, bells on loops of unequal length, bass, pulse) through tape echo and reverb. You do not play it, you tend it: choose a room and a scale, remove or put back notes.

commandes.role: Bell octave, from two below to two above, from any page.
Bell octave, from two below to two above, from any page.
Pad page: the four breathing voices.
Moves to the next chord, at the start of the next bar.
Garden page, the whole garden. Held with SELECT, sets the tempo from any page.
Saves the eight rooms; held 1.5 s, resets the room to its recipe.
Pushes or lays down: the garden stops growing and the sounds fade slowly; press again to restart it.
Freezes the chord: it holds and the reverb rings endlessly; press again to release.
Chooses the room, out of eight.
Chooses the mode (Ionian, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Aeolian, major and minor pentatonic) and loads its scale.
The scale: each key adds its note or removes it (the root stays, three notes minimum). Lit keys are the notes of the scale.

gestes: HOME held + SELECT: sets the tempo.
A button held for one second: a card says what it does.
a_savoir: KNOB 1 to 4 set the four values of the page; a layer's level is always on KNOB 1.
